definitions.explanation: Being at a suitable or comfortable level; neither too much nor too little.

examples.japanese: {程|ほど}よい⟦{距離感|きょりかん}→距離感：21956_kyorikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保|たも}つ→保つ：10134_tamotsu⟧。
{程|ほど}よい{甘|あま}さ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{美味|おい}しい→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧。
examples.english: It's delicious with just the right amount of sweetness.

examples.japanese: {程|ほど}よい⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧。
examples.english: Moderate exercise is good for health.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{程|ほど}→程：01724_hodo⟧ (degree, extent) + よい (good) → good degree = just right
- {程|ほど}よい⟦{距離感|きょりかん}→距離感：21956_kyorikan⟧ - appropriate distance (in relationships)
- {程|ほど}よい{甘|あま}さ - just the right sweetness
- {程|ほど}よく (adverb) - moderately, appropriately

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {程|ほど}よい⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧ - moderate exercise
- {程|ほど}よい⟦{緊張感|きんちょうかん}→緊張感：20207_kinchoukan⟧ - appropriate level of tension
- {程|ほど}よい⟦{塩加減|しおかげん}→塩加減：08575_shiokagen⟧ - just the right amount of salt

USAGE:
{程|ほど}よい emphasizes balance and moderation—the ideal middle ground. It's positive, suggesting something is perfectly suited to the situation.
